PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-inv-014.text: Malformed codeChallenge input must be rejected gracefully without unhandled exception.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-inv-014.assertion: forall input x: verifyCodeChallenge(x, c, m) returns bool, never throws

locations.note: No try-catch around crypto.createHash — malformed input could propagate Node.js crypto errors
